subject.description: Clean front-facing character reference sheet still of Cash, the Plainspoke mascot, centered full body, 2.5D retro rubber-hose cartoon, locked orthographic straight-on view. Cash is a chunky Arial Black dollar-sign glyph mascot with readable dollar-sign negative spaces, not a generic pillar, coin, or rounded rectangle. Preserve exact brand-rig colors: teal top highlight #48ecd6, teal base #27c8b4, teal lower shadow #149083, center cream stripe #fcefce to #eccd95 clipped to the dollar-sign vertical strokes, warm peach-orange lower-right bevel/extrusion #f88652, dark facial linework and pupils #16202e. Big eyes with tall oval pupils, expressive brows, subtle cheek blush, rubber-hose teal arms, stubby teal legs, friendly encouraging grin, no smugness. Flat cel shading, clean vector-like planes, no texture noise.

scene.location: minimal dark warm gradient studio background matching the expression sheet

lighting.type: single soft upper-left key light with subtle amber rim glow

color_palette.tone: warm dark background with teal dollar-sign character
